checks: migration is rerunnable, defaults disabled and requires engine enforcement for opt-in
anonymous/private-table access and forged QR entry points are denied
clock-in is QR-attributed; repeated frames and lost-response retries cannot become clock-out
active attendance requires employee-bound explicit confirmation; completed shifts cannot restart
QR checkout preserves manual check-in provenance and exact retries do not increment the version
stale/missing/imprecise/outside/boundary-overlapping locations fail with no partial attendance or redemption
session version changes invalidate confirmation and roll back privileged write context
expired confirmations and revoked displays cannot close a session
expired/tampered tokens and cross-branch scans fail
one station QR supports multiple separately authenticated employees
concurrent requests with different operation IDs redeem one employee/token once
concurrent confirmations close the bound session exactly once
a valid short-lived confirmation can outlive its original QR, with fresh GPS and reauthorization checks
revocation that commits while a scan waits for the station lock prevents attendance
